name: RTM
description: RTM (Related Through Money) is a street gang based in northwest Detroit, primarily active around Cody High School in the area known as the 'Skuddzone,' bounded by the Southfield Freeway and Greenfield Road to the west and east, and Plymouth Road and Joy Road to the north and south. The gang was federally indicted in 2015 under the Detroit One initiative on racketeering charges including narcotics distribution, murders, carjackings, and assaults.
